landmarks.name: Sedgespit Stack
landmarks.note: A flat shelf of scoured rock below the cliff, bare at low water and slick with weed.

landmarks.name: Alderspit Roads
landmarks.note: An old shoreline stranded above the present one, level enough to build a road on.

landmarks.name: Head among Aldereyot
landmarks.note: A finger of shingle the drift keeps building out across open water, growing every year.

landmarks.name: Mererun Roads
landmarks.note: A hole in the cliff top that spits spray and thunder whenever a big swell comes in.

landmarks.name: Bitternspit Geo
landmarks.note: A narrow slot cut back into the cliff along a weak seam, loud with water at the far end.

landmarks.name: Marrammere Stack
landmarks.note: A river mouth the sea has walked up, so the water is salt a long way inland.

landmarks.name: Head between Reedlobe
landmarks.note: A dark mouth in the cliff foot that the tide fills twice a day and empties again.

landmarks.name: Head at Tidalfall
landmarks.note: Ground that is mud at low water and sea at high, with no clear edge between them.

landmarks.name: Head below Willowlobe
landmarks.note: A stream that runs off the cliff lip and never reaches a beach, because there is none.

landmarks.name: Ford between Lagoonfall
landmarks.note: A long cut with the sky in a strip overhead and no way out for miles either side.

landmarks.name: Wrackrun Rake
landmarks.note: The wooded rise between the plain and the real mountains, cut by short steep valleys.

landmarks.name: Sedgerun Rake
landmarks.note: A shoulder running down off the main ridge, easy walking until it steepens.

landmarks.name: Loamshallow Rake
landmarks.note: A cave that is a split rather than a dissolved passage, opened when the rock moved.

landmarks.name: Reedholm Saddle
landmarks.note: A long hill with one gentle back and one abrupt face, like a wave about to break.

landmarks.name: Spar below Loamfall
landmarks.note: A peak with three clean faces meeting at a point, and nothing above it for a long way.

landmarks.name: Mire among Withylobe
landmarks.note: A bare salt patch inside the marsh where nothing grows and the crust holds water.
